findings.detail: Delayed Draw Term Loan identifier carries 2033-12-12, but the raw SOI maturity date is 12/12/2032.
Revolving Loan identifier carries 2034-12-12, but the raw SOI maturity date is 12/12/2032.

rationale: Class 2 within-row adjudication. The bundle's flagged generated identifiers disagree with the structured XBRL maturity value of 2032-12-12. Raw SOI rows for the same Peachtree Buyer delayed draw term loan and revolving loan both show maturity date 12/12/2032, so the structured maturity is source-grounded and the identifier maturities 2033-12-12 and 2034-12-12 are data errors.
